newFeatures.targetStory: As a kid, I can earn two extra stars by completing every task in a nonempty time period and see my progress toward that bonus.
newFeatures.targetNotes: Award once per child/Pacific day/named period. Empty periods earn nothing. Untimed Bonus chores are excluded. On-time requests can settle the original reward after later approval. Undo reverses it if incomplete; re-completion restores at most one net award. Replaces the ten-star daily bonus. Tapping the period card opens the current chore picker.
newFeatures.basis: explicit new two-star period completion requirement

implementation.verification: Domain suite: 2-star nonempty periods with no daily award, pending/missed work, undo/re-earn, exact records, midnight. Browser: period bonus and undo. Migration reconciles opening balances.

newFeatures.targetStory: As a parent, I can set the order of each child’s chores within a time period through ChatGPT and MCP.
newFeatures.targetNotes: Initial order is the September 8 Kids chores message, recorded in routine-order.md. Common tasks precede that child’s extras. Weekday filtering and temporary kid selection preserve saved order.
newFeatures.basis: explicit instruction to retain the written routine order

implementation.verification: Authenticated MCP transport test, catalog/history/day snapshots, named command validation. Domain tests: CRUD, assignments, orders, metadata, reward archival and historical prices.

confirmedDecisions.deviceTarget: The existing shared old iPad in landscape only; three persistent child columns. No phone, portrait, or desktop layout requirement.
confirmedDecisions.routineOrder: Exact written September 8 Kids chores order per child/period; common steps then individual extras; stable weekday filtering.
confirmedDecisions.periodBonus: Two additional stars per child/day/nonempty named period after all tasks complete; timely approvals may settle later; untimed Bonus excluded; undo reverses when incomplete. Replaces the ten-star daily bonus; no new daily awards or daily-bonus UI.
confirmedDecisions.timedChores: Only the active named window is kid-visible and accepts new submissions.
confirmedDecisions.untimedBonusChores: Remain available anytime, subject to date/assignment/recurrence eligibility.
confirmedDecisions.approvalAfterCutoff: An on-time accepted submission remains approvable later, including after its day ends.
confirmedDecisions.pastCompletion: No new backdated or elapsed-window submissions; later review of an on-time request is distinct.
confirmedDecisions.skip: Removed; no skip progress, bonus, or notification behavior.
confirmedDecisions.parentSurface: ChatGPT through MCP for parent management and approvals. Telegram only delivers notifications; no Clippy, Telegram conversation or action buttons, or dedicated parent UI.
confirmedDecisions.dataIsolation: Separate keys in the existing Redis database; copy source catalogs/history/balances once, then independent state.
confirmedDecisions.deviceAccess: Reuse the existing site-password login; already-unlocked iPads open /chores directly. Otherwise enter the same password. Invitation links remain optional.
confirmedDecisions.choreSwitcher: Tap the Finish this {timeframe} card to choose a current chore. No separate Choose another button. My progress remains inside the picker.
